mapper.insert: INSERT INTO archive_purchase_orders (id, order_no, invoice_no, supplier_id, warehouse_id, salesman_id, checker_id, keeper_id, biz_date, check_result, status, total_amount, created_by, confirmed_by, confirmed_at, remark, created_at, updated_at, archived_at) SELECT id, order_no, invoice_no, supplier_id, warehouse_id, salesman_id, checker_id, keeper_id, biz_date, check_result, status, total_amount, created_by, confirmed_by, confirmed_at, remark, created_at, updated_at, #{archivedAt} FROM purchase_orders WHERE status = '已过账' AND COALESCE(confirmed_at, created_at) < #{cutoff} ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}

INSERT INTO archive_purchase_order_items (id, order_id, drug_id, batch_no, production_date, expire_date, receive_qty, qualified_qty, stock_in_qty, purchase_price, amount, quality_status, spdid, remark, created_at, updated_at, archived_at) SELECT i.id, i.order_id, i.drug_id, i.batch_no, i.production_date, i.expire_date, i.receive_qty, i.qualified_qty, i.stock_in_qty, i.purchase_price, i.amount, i.quality_status, i.spdid, i.remark, i.created_at, i.updated_at, #{archivedAt} FROM purchase_order_items i INNER JOIN archive_purchase_orders a ON a.id = i.order_id WHERE a.archived_at = #{archivedAt} ORDER BY i.id LIMIT #{limit}
